name: Oda Nobunaga
title: Demon Daimyo
summary: Lead your clan to victory with powerful self-buffs, stat gains and joint Attacks
lore: A great daimyo before the Shattering, Oda Nobunaga led a series of wars that largely unified the provinces. Now he is a figure around which much of Izumo’s mortal population has rallied—but some lords of the realm choose to remain independent. Believing only a united Izumo can survive Ryven, Oda Nobunaga again readies himself to lead a war of unification.
